title: Evidence map: DDX58 (RIG-I) in the avian influenza corpus

cells.text:
H1N1 upregulates DDX58-derived
circRNAs in A549-PB1 cells
[circrna_2024]

note_box:
gene_evidence reports n_mechanisms=7 but no mechanism text is retrievable —
corpus searches return duck MDA5/IFIH1 instead of DDX58/RIG-I
caption: The only DDX58 evidence is one human circRNA expression study; the corpus repeatedly returns duck MDA5 (the parallel RIG-I-like receptor) instead. Avian DDX58 mechanisms, pathways, and phenotypes are absent.
footnote: Gap report briefing — searches: 3× corpus, 4× gene evidence. Figure: fig-ddx58-gap-map (spec-driven).
